notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a queued timestamped ordinary object deletion across Time Regulation disable and re-enable with a changed lookahead. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies Query Lookahead, removal-before-grant ordering, object identity cleanup, removal metadata, and terminal retraction without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped DeleteObjectInstance with DisableTimeRegulation/EnableTimeRegulation, Query Lookahead, and FederateAmbassador timestamped removal, time-role, and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped object-deletion/time-regulation declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
